title: Research: lower PR #2339's initial T74 prefix with 64 monomial applications

body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/t74-anticipatory-native-prefix/`, a finite native prefix and scoped grouping proof for both PR2339 80-alias T74 words. Each source lender supplies two initial corrections. Preparing its monomial once, performing both reads, and restoring the reference cuts 128 monomial applications to **64**, retaining all 64 scalar ADDs and adding **zero positive-rank recursive children**. Both forward and ordinary inverse-transpose prefixes are certified, including Gaussian phases and arbitrary dirty inputs.

The certificate contains the native monomial serialization, explicit address-coordinate XOR/phase gates and executed scalar scratch programs. The per-invocation, per-orientation scalar bound is 572 real-component primitive passes. Separate address bills are `(CNOT,CZ,Z4)=(1234,819,158)` for gauge44/base and `(1300,765,162)` for extra. These are finite operation inventories; 572 excludes address routing and is not a full-supplier overhead or tape-time bound. No optimality of 64 among other synthesis methods is claimed.

The generic expansion and K_G convention already belong to PR2226/2269. This contribution instantiates the changed PR2339 initial stage, groups its actual source reads safely, and checks complete native phase and boundary identities. It does not recertify the rest of the words.

PR2360 subsequently reports `b<0.0016870` for the full 400-helper stock on unchanged T74 bins. The README records that stronger cost boundary; no whole-inventory hosting build, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. Whole-word native phases/wrappers, 44 cleanup buffers, owner windows, complete costs/moment, recursive precision, layout/tape/all-size admission, outer transfer and the selected cold replay remain unchecked.

- **Scope status:** refined. Take the explicit native-prefix handoff on a suggested helper-inventory card. This closes one physical implementation obligation; the whole-supplier acceptance gate is not claimed. The other suggestions were passed over after checking covered decoder cases and active P104 chronological work.
- **Exact claim audited:** actual Gaussian initial correction, source/lender binding, dirty boundary and finite primitive bill; existing symbolic/free-operator validation is credited.
- **Method:** pinned exact compiler generation; independent permutation inversion, Gaussian phase reconstruction, primitive-gate interpreter, sparse exact boundary replay and semantic controls.
- **Optimistic budget:** reproduced the inherited call-weighted R48 relaxation in `[873979185987/500000000000000,69918334879/40000000000000]`; it is not a profile audit or completed invoice. The later whole-width cap stops a full-inventory attempt. Local success requires zero additional recursive children with all scalar/address operations exposed.
- **Success/stop:** complete finite prefix equality plus controls, or a concrete discrepancy; one bounded session, no full supplier search. Evidence and structured next questions are in TASK.json.
- **Artifact / reproduction:** the single new package, command below; no selected/frozen files changed.

Final shared-snapshot coverage: 583 open PRs fetched 2026-10-15T06:55:23.240869Z, 1,111 Discussion records fetched 06:57:32.010338Z, both with complete pagination. The changed-file index covers 572 PRs at 06:33:04.255876Z. Queries were the task card, `2339 / anticipatory / native initial prefix` (all 42 matches returned), and the proposed package path (zero matches). Offline warnings are expected; metadata search is not a novelty guarantee. The final board reread used the07:09:50.407275Z snapshot; the scoped claim was unchanged.

Nearest work: [PR2339](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2339) constructs the words and leaves native lowering open; [PR2269](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2269) supplies a general lowering but its shipped 43-high-alias words have no initial terms; [PR2360](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2360) prices whole-helper widths; [PR2359](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2359) audits different four-role raw rank ledgers; Discussion 2325/PR2363 optimize owners on other retained words. None supplies this grouped, source-bound initial prefix. Concurrent local claims were read; the second helper-inventory claim studies arbitrary-term P112 factorization, a distinct object/question.

## Validation

Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-anticipatory-native-prefix --check-only
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-anticipatory-native-prefix
python3 -I -O -B research/t74-anticipatory-native-prefix/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/t74-anticipatory-native-prefix/emit.py
```

The metadata/pin check, registered replay and optimized independent checker pass. The registered replay regenerates and compares the complete parsed payload. The independent checker imports no producer/compiler/predecessor implementation. Each provider has 128 phase-correct recipes checked on 512 columns; all four programs replay 32,768 active input columns each, and 286,720 untouched columns remain identity by footprint. Ungrouped prefixes are positive controls. All 24 rejecting semantic controls pass, with required rejection reasons, including wrong transpose convention and unclean coefficient scratch.

A read-only, Git-free optimized package export passes in 12.48s and preserves every file. Separate immutable-source, changed-receipt and occupied-output controls reject; the occupied file remains unchanged. A recompressed generated certificate is accepted by complete parsed-payload comparison. Source archives retain exact byte pins. `git diff --check` passes. No hosted CI, independent human review, complete native-word replay or selected cold replay is claimed.

Expected primary output:

```text
PASS_T74_ANTICIPATORY_NATIVE_PREFIX providers=2 orientations=2 terms=64 monomials=64 scalar_bound=572 controls=24 no_new_kappa
```

The registered replay (with regeneration) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about 14 seconds and left the worktree unchanged. The count checks by hand: 64 corrections come from 32 lenders, two each, so one preparation and one undo per lender gives 64 monomial applications instead of 2 x 64 = 128.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json give two scoped follow-ups: first screen a specified partial low-alias subset against the actual whole-helper bin stock; then, only for a survivor, bind initial reads to owners and integrate the prefix with all remaining native stages and a complete invoice. This result supplies no competitive subset and no whole-supplier admission.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The refreshed snapshot exposed PR2360 after the entry snapshot. That changed the full-inventory cost outlook while preserving the value of the already-completed finite prefix. Linking new whole-width obstructions directly from a construction's native-lowering handoff would make this distinction easier to find before broadening work.
